prompt: Find the requirements about brake temperature.

reference.rule: A requirement is about the phrase when its title or its description holds the phrase's words adjacent and in order, as whole words, case-insensitive, each word optionally followed by a plural s. The reply must name every such requirement; it must name none whose text holds none of the phrase's words (brake, temperature, thermal for the showcase: a thermal-protection requirement is not refused). HAZ_BTP_BRAKE_FADE is a stub with no text of its own and is neither required nor refused.
reference.computed_by: the rule over every requirement's title and description, read through the product's loader; no query derivation searches text, so the test recomputes it from the loaded model
